description: Developed a versatile collection of official merchandise designs for Alcove Chronicles Studio, based on their original Webtoon comic series. The project focused on translating webtoon characters, iconic narrative moments, and visual motifs into compelling graphic designs suitable for apparel, accessories, and collectible items.
